body.text: Dynamic Pruning and Progressive State Compaction

Modern agent frameworks implement progressive compaction: as conversation depth exceeds predefined token thresholds, intermediate tool responses (such as file reads and compilation logs) are recursively collapsed into structured diffs and decision trees. This preserves the agent’s reasoning trajectory while reducing token consumption by up to eighty percent.
